d: Snoonu is expanding its portfolio of real-time mobility and on-demand services, requiring strong operational foundations to ensure reliability, efficiency and customer trust.The Operations Manager will be responsible for translating business requirements into effective operating processes across dispatch, routing, fleet/supply coordination, and real-time service execution, ensuring service readiness, maintaining performance standards and resolving operational issues as the business scales. This is a high-ownership role for someone who combines operational discipline with strong stakeholder management and is comfortable working across internal teams and external driver, fleet and mobility partners in a fast-moving, geo-optimised environment.
q: 5 – 7 years in operations, mobility, ride-hailing, logistics or real-time dispatch environments.
Hands-on experience with driver/fleet operations or supply-side management.
Strong understanding of dispatch systems, routing, GPS-based operations or real-time service platforms.
Ability to operate in high-pressure, time-sensitive environments where execution speed matters.
Strong analytical skills with experience using real-time operational data to drive decisions.
Experience working in Qatar or GCC mobility/logistics ecosystems is a plus.

r: Real-Time Operations Execution — Run day-to-day mobility operations including dispatch, trip fulfilment, routing efficiency and live service performance.
Supply & Driver Operations — Manage driver/fleet readiness, availability, onboarding and performance to ensure consistent service coverage.
Dispatch & Matching Efficiency — Ensure optimal real-time matching of demand and supply across zones, time windows and peak conditions.
Service Performance — Own core mobility KPIs including pickup time, trip completion, cancellations, ETA accuracy and utilisation.
Geo-Operations Planning — Monitor demand patterns and ensure correct driver positioning and coverage across locations and peak periods.
Incident Management — Resolve live operational issues such as trip failures, delays, driver no-shows and system disruptions.
Operational Standards — Define and enforce SOPs for trip lifecycle, driver behaviour, dispatch rules and exception handling.
Cross-Functional Execution — Work closely with Product, Tech, Data and Commercial teams to ensure systems and operations are aligned and executable.
Continuous Improvement — Use operational data to identify gaps and improve speed, reliability and efficiency of mobility operations.
